title: Bleed brakes (two-person or one-person method)
parts: Correct brake fluid (DOT 3/4/5.1 per cap; DOT 5 silicone only if system already uses it)
warnings: Never let the master cylinder run dry during bleeding
Brake fluid strips paint. Rinse spills with water right away.
Many ABS units trap air in the modulator and need a scan-tool "automated bleed". Check the vehicle before chasing a soft pedal forever.
steps: Fill the master cylinder with fresh fluid.
Typical order is farthest wheel first: RR, LR, RF, LF. Some vehicles (diagonal split, some imports) differ, so check.
Put the hose on the bleeder, other end submerged in fluid in the bottle.
Helper presses the pedal slowly and holds it down. Open the bleeder about 1/4 turn, let fluid and air out, close the bleeder, then helper releases the pedal.
Repeat until fluid runs clear with no bubbles. Top off the master every few pumps.
Check pedal: should be firm and high with the engine running. If it sinks slowly, look for a leak or a bypassing master cylinder.
